dolomites.overview: World-class hiking among sheer limestone towers and alpine pastures, with a hut-to-hut tradition led by the 75-mile Alta Via 1, a strenuous 10 to 13 day trek. Day hikes range from the moderate Tre Cime di Lavaredo loop to meadow walks. Tre Cime, Seceda and Lago di Braies draw the summer crowds; the Fanes plateau, Pale di San Martino and Friulian Dolomites are far quieter. Huts and cable cars run from late June to September.

madeira.overview: Madeira is famous for its levada trails, paths beside old irrigation channels that wind through laurel forest and steep valleys, from flat strolls to ledges above deep gorges. The headline walk is the exposed ridge from Pico do Arieiro to Pico Ruivo, 6,110 ft, with dramatic volcanic views when the cloud lifts. Walkable all year, but winter rain and storms can close trails; spring and early autumn are best.

cape-town.overview: Cape Town has exceptional day hiking: Table Mountain and Lion's Head above the center, then Silvermine, Chapman's Peak and the fynbos trails of Cape Point on the peninsula. An hour or so out, Jonkershoek near Stellenbosch and the Kogelberg coast near Betty's Bay offer waterfalls and mountain valleys, and a two-day hut trail circles the Cape of Good Hope. Spring and autumn are best.

chicago.overview: Day hikers drive an hour or two to the canyons and waterfalls of Starved Rock State Park or the dunes of Indiana Dunes. Spring has the best waterfalls and mid to late October the best color; summer is hot and buggy.

months.12: Early snow and freezing temperatures turn the dirt paths icy, so outings are short and cold. Bald eagles begin gathering on the Illinois River near Starved Rock.

sedona.overview: Sedona offers an exceptional network of day hikes through red sandstone canyons and across slickrock, with sweeping desert views. Bell Rock and Courthouse Butte are gentle walks around the buttes, while Cathedral Rock is short but steep, a hands-on scramble up bare rock. Boynton Canyon is a shadier option. Spring and autumn are best; summer afternoons are too hot for walking.
